mapper.select: SELECT id AS contractSourceId,contractNo,projectGroupCode,createTime AS contractCreateTime,createBy AS contractCreateBy,updateTime AS contractUpdateTime,updateBy AS contractUpdateBy FROM pm_project_contract ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id AS groupId,projectGroupCode AS groupProjectGroupCode,projectGroupName AS groupProjectGroupName,projectType,createTime AS groupCreateTime,createBy AS groupCreateBy,updateTime AS groupUpdateTime,updateBy AS groupUpdateBy FROM pm_project_group WHERE projectType='10' ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id AS memberId,projectGroupCode AS memberProjectGroupCode,projectCode AS memberProjectCode,mergeBranchMark,smsProjectCode,createTime AS memberCreateTime,createBy AS memberCreateBy,updateTime AS memberUpdateTime,updateBy AS memberUpdateBy FROM pm_project_group_relationship ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.projectId AS originalProjectId,p.projectCode AS originalProjectCode,company.compCode AS originalCompanyCode FROM pm_project p JOIN (SELECT CAST(projectType AS BINARY) AS typeKey,CAST(projectCode AS BINARY) AS codeKey,MAX(projectId) AS projectId FROM pm_project GROUP BY CAST(projectType AS BINARY),CAST(projectCode AS BINARY)) chosen ON chosen.projectId=p.projectId LEFT JOIN t_company company ON company.id=p.compId WHERE p.disabled=0 AND p.effectiveTo IS NULL AND p.projectType='10' ORDER BY p.projectId LIMIT #{limit}
